body: POST /signals/waiting and the CLI's signal-waiting exist, but the admin UI has no form for them, and a waiting run's page does not say which event and key it waits for. Add a signal-waiting form (name, key, payload; answers how many resumed), show the wait's event and key on a waiting run, and, once the SignalRun route exists, a Signal button on that run. Recapture run-waiting-light.png with task docs:screenshots.
title: Admin UI: buttons for signal-waiting and SignalRun
